name: Vegetable Poha with Peas
ingredients: ½ cup green peas, fresh or frozen
steps: Place poha in a sieve and rinse briefly under running water. Drain thoroughly; season lightly with salt and turmeric.
Heat oil; add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add onion and carrot and cook 3 minutes.
Add peas and 2 tbsp water; cover for 2–3 minutes until tender.
Fold in softened poha gently. Cover on low heat for 2 minutes, then turn off the heat.
Finish with lemon, coriander and pumpkin seeds. Fluff with a fork and serve.
note: Rinse thick poha quickly rather than soaking it; over-soaking makes it sticky.
